messages:
deploy-bot: Starting image build + push for service/cache-writer (commit 9f3b2a7, tag build-20270315-57).
deploy-bot: Target registries: acr.dev.redwood.local/cache-writer:build-20270315-57 -> will async-copy to acr.prod.redwood.local/cache-writer:release-20270315.
samir: noted. running on the canary window (0800-1000 PT) per change calendar.
jess: ETA on manifest push? need to update the release notes before promote.
deploy-bot: Build complete. Starting push (parallel blobs) to acr.dev... showing chunked upload.
registry-bot: [acr.dev.redwood.local] blob upload 1/6 failed: 503 Service Unavailable. Retrying with exponential backoff.
samir: seeing intermittent 503s from ACR in the last hour. retry is fine but if it keeps failing we may need to re-run with smaller concurrency.
deploy-bot: Retry 2 succeeded for blob 1. Continue.
deploy-bot: Push progress: blobs 6/6, manifest upload...
registry-bot: manifest upload failed: 504 Gateway Timeout (upload/manifest). Will retry.
jess: if manifest keeps timing out, consider switching to single manifest push (no OCI index) to avoid multi-arch overhead for this canary.
kai: ack. but this is amd64-only for now so single manifest is fine. can we retag locally and push manifest v2?
deploy-bot: Adjusted push: using manifest v2, single-arch, reducing manifest size. Re-attempting manifest put.
registry-bot: manifest put success. acr.dev.redwood.local/cache-writer:build-20270315-57 -> digest sha256:0a7f3e4c9b8d2a6f5c9e2d7b1a4c6f8d9e0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4
deploy-bot: Initiating cross-repo async copy to acr.prod.redwood.local. Copy job id: copy-20270315-1142.
registry-bot: cross-repo copy accepted. Job copy-20270315-1142 queued.
samir: good. please pin canary route to that digest instead of the tag while we observe.
kai: triggering canary rollout using digest sha256:0a7f3e4c9b8d... (pin applied to route cache-writer:canary -> sha256)
ingrid: adding entry to release notes: "cache-writer: new build pushed to dev ACR; cross-repo async copy to prod initiated; canary pinned to digest 0a7f3e4c". I'll push a short blurb to the docs.
registry-bot: copy-20270315-1142 status: in_progress (transferring blobs).
registry-bot: copy-20270315-1142 status: completed. acr.prod.redwood.local/cache-writer:release-20270315 -> digest sha256:0a7f3e4c9b8d2a6f5c9e2d7b1a4c6f8d9e0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4
deploy-bot: Cross-repo copy finished. Prod tag published but not promoted to traffic yet.
jess: thanks. I'll add the push/digest to the release notes and the changelog entry. We should wait 30m observation window per canary policy.
samir: agree. if we see error rate spike >0.5% or latency regression >20% we rollback by repinning canary to previous digest sha256:7c1d2e3f...
kai: set a dashboard alert for the next 30m and a rollback playbook link: https://wiki/internal/canary-playbook
deploy-bot: Finished push pipeline for build-20270315-57. Workflow run id: wf-8421. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/wf-8421
jess: :thumbsup: well done. I'll follow up with release notes update and a short note in #product to signal the canary window.
samir: leaving monitoring on, ping me if anything odd.
